_meta.title: FF Pose Video
_meta.note: The DRIVING video: the performance whose motion is transferred onto the character. LoadVideo takes an input-dir ref (jobs/<id>/clip.mp4). Wan-Animate copies this performance — it cannot invent one, so a bad read in the driver is a bad read in the output.

_meta.title: FF Video Components
_meta.note: Splits the driving video into frames / audio / fps. fps (output 2) and audio (output 1) are link-wired straight into FF Create Video, so the OUTPUT INHERITS THE DRIVER'S FRAME RATE AND AUDIO — nothing is resampled and no rate is hardcoded.

_meta.title: FF Character Ref
_meta.note: The character master: one still of the person to animate. Feeds both reference_image and the CLIP-vision encode. Identity is anchored to THIS frame, so keep one canonical still per character and reuse it for every shot.

_meta.title: FF CLIP Vision Loader
_meta.note: clip_vision_h — the vision tower that turns the character still into an identity embedding.

_meta.title: FF CLIP Vision
_meta.note: Encodes the character ref. crop 'none' keeps the full frame; cropping here would re-frame the identity.

_meta.title: FF UNet
_meta.note: Wan-Animate 2 distilled int8 (convrot). Distilled = the 10-step / cfg 1.0 recipe below; raising steps or cfg fights the distillation.

_meta.title: FF Animate Cache
_meta.note: Activation cache on CPU. device 'cpu' is the safe choice — 'cuda' is faster but competes with the sampler for VRAM on a 32GB card.

_meta.title: FF VAE
_meta.note: wan 2.1 VAE — shared by the latent build and the decode.

_meta.title: FF Positive
_meta.note: Patched by buildWanAnimate. Describes the SCENE and the character's appearance; the MOTION comes from the driving video, not from here.

inputs.text: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, watermark, text

_meta.title: FF Animate
_meta.note: WanAnimate2ToVideo. width/height/length patched per request. NOTE: this node has NO background_video and NO character_mask input (the older WanAnimateToVideo does) — the frame is REGENERATED from the reference, so the driver's real background does not survive. Composite over a real plate with the MATTE lane if the background must be kept.

_meta.title: FF Sampler
_meta.note: Distilled recipe: 10 steps, cfg 1.0, euler/simple. seed patched per request.

_meta.title: FF Trim
_meta.note: Trims the latent by the offset WanAnimate2ToVideo reports (output 3).

_meta.title: FF Create Video
_meta.note: fps and audio come from FF Video Components, so the render matches the driver exactly.
